newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Hong Kong had invested in 6,773 projects with a total value of $10.607 billion in Shanghai by the end of April, remaining the biggest single investor among the 69 countries and regions which have invested in Shanghai.
- New York-based bank holding firm Chase Manhattan Corp has opened its first branch office in Shanghai and will seek a licence for conducting local currency business.

- BUSINESS NEWS - China's air-conditioner industry has become chaotic with yearly output of around eight million air-conditioners and annual production capacity of 20.4 million against demand for only 7.2 million units.
